# Content coverage (generated by `npm run coverage`; do not edit)

Hand-written questions are individually authored; templated questions are built from the vocabulary table by a deterministic template (e.g. one meaning question per word) and are reported separately. Runtime-generated practice (kana drills, flashcards) is not stored and not counted here. Counts are items at `auto_checked` or higher. `auto_checked` means "passed the automated checks A01-A16/X01-X11", **not** reviewed by a person. `human_reviewed` share is 0 because no human reviewer exists (U-010, L-10). Level tags are instructional (unofficial).
